title: Split runtime handle task supervision and restart state helpers
description: Runtime handle currently owns the runtime object, start/stop handles, platform task joins, mock test helpers, and restart state transfer. Split task supervision and restart state handling before adding richer platform reload/status behavior.

files.change: Keep public RuntimeHandle/AstrbotRuntime exports stable while delegating internals.
Move JoinHandle abort/join handling and platform/event-bus task supervision out of the handle facade.
Isolate provider preference snapshot/restore policy from stop/start mechanics.

criteria: Runtime start, stop, restart, and sent-message helper behavior remains unchanged.
Task abort/join error mapping is tested independently.
Future platform reload/status work can reuse the supervisor boundary.
